proof_scope: Projected energy is C1 under every continuous real perturbation, with any relative finite-energy base. Finite-integral variational maximizers are exactly prescribed-measure solutions. Bounded-density measures of matching reference mass admit normalized relative E1 solutions. Every positive-parameter exponential full-mass solution dominates a supersolution for any finite non-pluripolar measure; hence it is unique. Bounded-density exponential measures admit a unique relative E1 variational solution. General non-pluripolar existence, unweighted uniqueness and relative boundedness estimates remain unproved here.
